actions.name: take_gems
actions.description: Choose at most three physical colored gems for this action; use the current DecisionFrame to decide whether they are three distinct colors or one legal same-color pair.

colors.description: One entry per physical colored gem, never more than three entries; repeat one color only for a currently legal same-color pair.

actions.name: buy_card
actions.description: Buy one visible market card or one card reserved by this seat, choosing the physical tokens paid after bonuses.

card.description: Stable card identifier from the current DecisionFrame.

payment.description: One entry per physical token spent, after the displayed bonuses have already been applied. Repeat colors for multiple tokens; G replaces any color. Example: [C,C,G] pays two C tokens and one gold. Use [] only when payableAfterBonuses is zero in every color.

actions.name: reserve_card
actions.description: Reserve one visible market card or the top card of a deck level.

card.description: Market card identifier or deck level from the current DecisionFrame.

actions.name: discard_gem
actions.description: Choose a colored or gold gem returned to satisfy the token limit.

actions.name: choose_noble
actions.description: Choose one currently eligible noble when the authority exposes a real choice.

noble.description: Stable noble identifier from the current DecisionFrame.
